controls.title: Organization and its context
controls.description: Determine internal/external issues relevant to the SMSs purpose.

controls.title: Interested parties
controls.description: Identify interested parties and their service management requirements.

controls.title: SMS scope
controls.description: Define and document the scope of the service management system.

controls.title: SMS and its processes
controls.description: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the SMS.

controls.title: Leadership and commitment
controls.description: Top management demonstrates leadership/commitment to the SMS.

controls.title: Policy
controls.description: Establish a service management policy appropriate to the organization.

controls.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
controls.description: Assign and communicate SMS-relevant roles and authorities.

controls.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
controls.description: Plan actions addressing SMS risks/opportunities identified in context analysis.

controls.title: Service management objectives and planning
controls.description: Set measurable service management objectives and plans to achieve them.

controls.title: Plan the SMS
controls.description: Plan changes to the SMS in a controlled, consistent manner.

controls.title: Resources
controls.description: Determine and provide resources needed for the SMS.

controls.title: Competence
controls.description: Ensure people doing SMS-relevant work are competent.

controls.title: Awareness
controls.description: Ensure relevant personnel are aware of the service policy and their contribution.

controls.title: Communication
controls.description: Determine internal/external communications relevant to the SMS.

controls.title: Documented information
controls.description: Maintain documented information required by the SMS and the standard.

controls.title: Operational planning and control
controls.description: Plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet service requirements.

controls.title: Service portfolio management
controls.description: Define, agree, and maintain the portfolio of services offered.

controls.title: Relationship and agreement management
controls.description: Manage business/customer/supplier relationships and service level agreements.

controls.title: Supply and demand management
controls.description: Manage demand for services and ensure adequate supply/capacity.

controls.title: Service design
controls.description: Design new/changed services to meet agreed requirements.

controls.title: Service transition
controls.description: Control the transition of new/changed services into live operation.

controls.title: Resolution and fulfilment - incident management
controls.description: Manage incidents to restore agreed service levels as quickly as possible.

controls.title: Resolution and fulfilment - problem management
controls.description: Identify and manage root causes of incidents to prevent recurrence.

controls.title: Resolution and fulfilment - service request management
controls.description: Manage the lifecycle of service requests from users.

controls.title: Service assurance - availability management
controls.description: Ensure services meet agreed availability commitments.

controls.title: Service assurance - information security management
controls.description: Manage information security risks within service delivery.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Control changes to services/components in a managed, risk-aware manner.

controls.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.description: Monitor/measure SMS and service performance against objectives.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.description: Conduct planned internal audits of the SMS.

controls.title: Management review
controls.description: Top management periodically reviews the SMS for continuing suitability.

controls.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
controls.description: Identify nonconformities and take corrective action.

controls.title: Continual improvement
controls.description: Continually improve the suitability/adequacy/effectiveness of the SMS.
